_comment: Capability-root manifest for iac/ (ADR-0562 / founder ruling oyatie-0s8). This is the capability's OWN service manifest — the `<root>/manifest.json` shape that ci/facade/service-tier-metadata treats as top-level. No absorbed sub-service manifests exist under iac/*/manifest.json; every crate, contract and OpenSLO path below was read off the iac/ tree, not transcribed from the pre-rehome cloud-iac layout.
dr_tier_derivation: Grounded from the pre-rehome cloud-iac service facet (T1) and retained: there is no absorbed sub-service to inherit a stricter class from, and the five crates under iac/ sit on the IaC control-plane failure path.

substrate_dag_position._note: ADR-0562 capability-registry declares iac tier=substrate stratum=S0 (dag_node=iac).

purpose: Infrastructure-as-code substrate + GitOps reconciliation surfaces (ADR-0562 charter). The five workspace crates under iac/ are the domain model, API boundary, REST port, infrastructure adapter and local app composition root for metadata-only OpenTofu module registry / GitOps evidence work — plus the in-tree tofu module catalog, cell-topology fixture and OpenSLO files under iac/observability/slos/.

bounded_contexts.name: iac-core
bounded_contexts.description: Domain + API boundary crates under iac/core/.

capability_root_accounting._overlap_note: COMPUTED, not asserted. No iac/*/manifest.json absorbed-service manifests exist; all five Cargo.toml packages under iac/{adapters,core,facade,ports}/ are owned exclusively by this root.

adrs.title: Closed Capability Registry And Deterministic Placement

sharding_automation.non_claim: This capability root does not claim a live tenant-shard control plane. Autosharding OpenSLO under iac/observability/slos/autosharding-events.openslo.yaml is retained as an authored objective; ADR-0348 automation stays disabled here until a measured runtime control plane exists.

dr.non_claim: `dr_tier` above is the inherited reliability obligation for the IaC control-plane path, not a measured failover result for this capability root.

foundation_non_claims: this manifest describes the 5 crates directly under iac/ and the verified in-tree contracts/OpenSLO/tofu catalog paths listed above; it does NOT restate CI gates, marketplace/dev-cli helpers, or crates that live outside iac/

no production-deployed listener, object-store registry, Argo CD control plane, provider plan/apply runtime, or measured DR drill is claimed by this capability-root slice beyond what the listed OpenSLO files themselves declare as objectives
slos_note: All seven OpenSLO files live under iac/observability/slos/ and belong to this capability root (no absorbed sub-service manifests). Paths verified against the tree at authoring time.
